name_zh: 相关参考误差的矩阵校正
formal_object: Raw error E_t=F_t-Y_t and observable r0=F_a-x; centered e_t=E_t-mu_t, r=r0-mu_a; C_aa=E[rr^T] positive definite; C_ta=E[e_t r^T].

operations.condition: Residual moments are finite and centered; B fitted outside confirmation
C_aa is positive definite on retained directions

derivation_steps.statement: R(B)=tr C_tt-2 tr(B C_at)+tr(B C_aa B^T).

derivation_steps.justification: Set the convex quadratic derivative to zero.

derivation_steps.statement: R(0)-R(B*)=tr(C_ta C_aa^-1 C_at)>=0 under the stipulated true moments.
derivation_steps.justification: The Schur-complement term is positive semidefinite.

derivation_steps.statement: For fitted B=B*+E, centered excess risk is tr(E C_aa E^T).
derivation_steps.justification: Complete the square; estimated moments can erase any ideal benefit.

derivation_steps.statement: Using fitted means adds squared bias ||mu_t-muhat_t+B(muhat_a-mu_a)||^2 to centered risk.
derivation_steps.justification: After output F_t-muhat_t-B(r0-muhat_a), separate its deterministic mean from the zero-mean centered error.

assumptions: Centering and cross-covariance have to be calibrated from legal development information, not confirmation labels at inference.
Self-residual r is observable; true C_ta is not automatically observable or calibrated by model perturbations.
If moments cannot be estimated credibly, this stays a mathematical hypothesis with a calibration blocker.
Singular directions are restricted or regularized; ridge changes the exact optimum and must be recorded.
method_expression: Fit means and a declared B_t estimator on legal development/replay evidence, freeze them, and output F_t-muhat_t-B_t((F_a-x)-muhat_a); use an exact anchor override. Low-rank/ridge estimates are approximations to the unrestricted ideal formula. Compare with mean-only and fixed-unit subtraction.
distinguishing_prediction: A matrix correction should beat unit subtraction specifically when reference/downstream errors are anisotropic and correlated; its matrix component should switch off for zero cross-covariance, while any separately fitted mean correction remains.
falsifier: Reject if legal moment estimates are unstable across assets or any improvement disappears against fixed subtraction/diagonal correction at matched calibration budget.
closest_alternative: Classical matrix control variates and generalized least squares; historical research_math.correlated is related provenance, not math-first evidence for this new batch.
decisive_comparison: Full native scoring of uncorrected, unit subtraction, diagonal B and low-rank cross-covariance B; development-only fitting and fresh paired confirmation.
operational_delta: An estimated error-transfer operator and its estimation-risk term differ from C01's parameter-free boundary guarantee; this nesting is not causal independence.
feasibility_and_cost: Observed self-map residual plus development calibration; no new training, but several native redecodes/perturbations may be needed. Cost and moment access remain unmeasured.
structural_signature: Statistical matrix estimator learned from error cross-moments, with explicit estimation penalty.
algebra_review_basis: Completed the risk square and checked B=0, B=I and zero cross-covariance limits. Ideal risk reduction is only under true centered moments.
empirical_status: Not implemented in this round; no native method comparison or outcome.
originality_status: Unadjudicated. Classical tools and historical related code are explicitly attributed.
